locator.section: In vigilia Ascensionis; Et dicitur Gloria in excelsis after the Introit

entries.claim: The Ascension Vigil explicitly directs Et dicitur Gloria in excelsis after its Introit. This supports inclusion of the Gloria in this proper. It supplies no new full-body Gloria transcription or target-language wording.
